d: We are supporting a hospitality investment and asset management group in Oman with the appointment of a Technical Asset Manager.
In line with the organisation's current Omanisation requirements, this position is designated for Omani nationals.

This is an opportunity for a technically strong hospitality professional to join an owner-side asset management function and support the condition, performance, maintenance and long-term value of a portfolio of hotel assets.

The Technical Asset Manager will support the planning, monitoring and control of maintenance, facilities operations and technical asset management activities across operating hotel assets and shareholder properties.

Working from the owner side, the role will collaborate closely with hotel operators, General Managers, engineering teams, consultants, contractors, service providers, specialist vendors and internal stakeholders to ensure assets are maintained to the required technical, operational, safety and compliance standards.

The position will have particular exposure to CAPEX planning, Property Improvement Plans, asset condition reviews, lifecycle maintenance planning, contractor performance, renovations, technical reporting, handovers and operational readiness.
q: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Facilities Management or another relevant technical discipline.
6–10 years of relevant experience in hotel engineering, technical asset management, facilities management, maintenance planning, project coordination or owner-side asset operations.
Proven exposure to hotel operations, CAPEX planning, Property Improvement Plans, contractor management and asset condition reviews.
Strong understanding of hotel engineering, building systems, maintenance standards, asset condition assessment and lifecycle planning.
Experience reviewing and monitoring OPEX, CAPEX, renovations, upgrades and property improvement works.
Strong understanding of HSE standards, statutory compliance, technical standards and contractor management.
Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with hotel operators, General Managers, engineering teams, consultants, contractors, vendors and internal teams.
Hands-on, execution-oriented and commercially aware, with the ability to manage multiple priorities across operating assets and technical projects.
Professional certifications such as PMP, CFM, FMP, hospitality engineering, asset management or equivalent would be an advantage.
Candidates with a strong hotel engineering or technical project background who are ready to broaden their experience into owner-side technical asset management are encouraged to apply.
r: Support the preparation and review of hotel CAPEX plans, Property Improvement Plans and technical improvement priorities.
